description_short: Read a logging or audit standard and extract a requirement profile that log samples can be tested against.
description_long: Reads a logging, auditing or observability standard (a PDF or text artifact, public or internal) and writes a requirement profile as JSON: one entry per requirement with its clause, an exact quote, its obligation level, the record elements it needs from a closed catalogue (timestamp, event type, outcome, actor identity, source address and others), and whether a log sample can show it at all. Requirements about retention, protection or review are kept and marked not_assessable_from_sample. Every quote is searched for in the locally extracted document text and flagged when it is not found. Use it once per standard, before log_compliance_auditor, which takes the profile as its grounding. Actions: extract_profile (one or a few heavy-tier calls; the result is marked draft_unreviewed until a person confirms it) and validate_profile (deterministic and free; checks a generated or hand-written profile). Not auto-invocable because extract_profile costs heavy-tier calls.
